title: Afghanistan War Exposed: An Imperial Conspiracy (Full Documentary)
summary: An Empire Files documentary by Abby Martin presenting a critical account of the Afghanistan War, from the CIA's role in the 1980s to the stalemate of the 2010s and 2020. It argues the war was driven by imperial interests.
why: Mentioned only in passing, cited as support for claims that US interventions were driven by resources and that Western war reporting is biased.
